notes:
- New built-in add-on **3D converter**: right-click a model → "Convert model to ›" (Non-CAD: GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, 3MF… · CAD: STEP, IGES…) or open the converter window for many files and more formats
- Game / graphics formats (GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL, PLY, USDZ, Draco – from FBX, DAE, 3MF, 3DS, VOX, Rhino 3DM and more) convert right away, with textures embedded or copied next to the model
- 3MF for slicers (Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, Cura) from any model – also from STEP / IGES / DWG: millimetres, Z up, welded mesh, material colours
- CAD (STEP, IGES, BREP, DXF, DWG) through free engines downloaded on first use (Mayo, LibreDWG), with mesh quality draft / normal / fine; FBX, USD, Alembic and .blend through your installed Blender
- Results are saved next to the originals and never overwrite anything; closed formats (SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion…) get a clear hint to export STEP
- Fix: the right-click menu sometimes highlighted the wrong item until the mouse moved
